transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This outage happened during our dinner rush! We lost probably $3000 in sales because customers couldn't pay with cards.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am so sorry this happened during your busiest time. I can only imagine how stressful that must have been for you and your staff. Let me see what I can do to make this right.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We had to turn away customers. Some regulars were really upset. This can't happen again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand your concern about your regular customers - they're the heart of your business. I'm going to arrange for backup internet and a full service credit for tonight's outage.
